basis.browser: Chromium headless shell 156; supplemental local evidence with real signed seats and PostgreSQL. CI uses the repository-pinned Playwright browser and remains authoritative.
basis.step_method: Wall time between completed named checks, including assertions and evidence; seat setup excluded. Budgets round up 2.5 times observed duration plus 1.5s, with 3s minimum. Existing 3s delivery and 15s reveal assertions remain unchanged. New regression journeys use the measured related journey plus explicit protocol waits.
basis.api_budget_reason: 2s exceeds four times the observed 459ms maximum; exact injected delays are recorded separately.
basis.assignment_budget_reason: The measured 8.3s assignment journey has 23s headroom plus 20s for the existing 15s authoritative lobby poll; old-character DOM and sheet access are checked before restoring assignments.
basis.profile_budget_reason: The profile identity poll has a 15s protocol interval; 22s covers that wait and reload. Initial identity recovery budgets use the measured 1.509s first-read recovery baseline plus navigation and signed self reads.
basis.sheet_conflict_budget_reason: Concurrency checks retain individual 6s refresh limits. 45s covers nonoverlapping merge, a real stale-save 409, and explicit overlapping-conflict recovery; 35s covers submission, clipboard recovery, return, new version and approval. Based on the measured 17.22s four-refresh sheet loop plus additional protocol waits.
basis.pin_budget_reason: The focused real-browser success/refusal/retry journey measured 2.495s at 1280px and 2.536s at 390px. The 8s budget follows the same 2.5-times-plus-1.5s rule. Removing only the two disabled props made this check fail at both widths.
basis.reply_reassignment_budget_reason: 35s covers the measured single-expiry recovery (~10s), cancellation/reselection, and real assignment/restoration interactions. The earlier four-change assignment journey measured 8.3s; existing 6s UI refresh and exact audience assertions remain unchanged.
basis.sheet_recovery_budget_reason: New recovery checks use the existing assignment and sheet-conflict baselines plus explicit five-second polls: 45s for four assignment transitions; 25s each for account/expiry and membership; 15s for explicit sign-out and re-login. Every individual access-loss and restore assertion retains its six-second deadline. Existing budgets are unchanged.
